change_summary: Material predawn model-guidance change. Fresh NGOFS2 guidance at the 04:48 CDT reference changed from approximately +46/+109/+63/-260 m to -43/-163/-345/-421 m at 1/3/6/12 hours, reversing the three near-term windows from shoreward to seaward and strengthening the 12-hour seaward signal. The 05:12-05:16 owner-camera cycle passed 6/6 healthy with 3/3 frames and no aggregate temporal Jubilee signal, but nighttime biology remained poorly observable. Grand Hotel and Fairhope advanced during direct 34.751-second samples at 05:32-05:33 with no human event signal; biology remained UNKNOWN in darkness. Opportunity decreased to Point Clear 1-3% and Daphne/May Day 1-2%.
